prompt: Which situation most likely led to the two sales Mei mentions?
promptZh: 最可能是哪種情況導致梅提到的兩筆交易？
evidence: “For those orders, the website uses only the cabinet count at the shop with the window. It never adds any stock from the other branch.” / “The market shop still runs the window, right?” / “Right. The market shop sends returns straight to the station shop. None go back into the market cabinet. Paid orders stay inside until the customers pick them up, though.”

options.text: A tin waiting for collection was counted at the market shop.
options.zh: 市場店把一罐等顧客取貨的茶算進庫存。
options.whyZh: 正確。窗口訂單只看市場店櫃子；已付款未取件的茶罐留在裡面，而網站會持續把櫃內的茶罐列為仍可購買。

options.text: A returned tin waiting for inspection was counted at the market shop.
options.zh: 市場店把一罐退回、等候檢查的茶算進庫存。
options.whyZh: 市場店是對的門市，但它的退貨不會放進自己的櫃子。

options.text: A tin waiting for collection was counted at the station shop.
options.zh: 車站店把一罐等顧客取貨的茶算進庫存。
options.whyZh: 未取件確實會被櫃子計入，但車站店的數量沒有進入窗口訂單。

options.text: A returned tin waiting for inspection was counted at the station shop.
options.zh: 車站店把一罐退回、等候檢查的茶算進庫存。
options.whyZh: 退貨可能出現在接收退貨的車站店，但即使被計入也不會影響窗口訂單。

explanationZh: 正確。窗口訂單只看市場店櫃子；已付款未取件的茶罐留在裡面，而網站會持續把櫃內的茶罐列為仍可購買。
